_comment: End-to-end disagreements on the CI golden, reviewed. One entry per (unit, token) with its cause: tagger (compromise tags the word differently and the reading changes), stress-only (same segments, stress moved), heteronym (a heteronym-table form, outside the parity bar and guarded by the explainer C3 lint), tokenizer (none: the tokenizer port is at 100 %). parity.golden.test.ts fails on an unlisted disagreement and on a listed token that now agrees.
